• Pentru ipoteza f₀≈10/N, N=8–12 dă 0,83: • With the assumed f₀≈10/N, N=8–12 gives 0.83–1.25 Hz, which does not exactly match 0.71 Hz. Resonance depends on frequency and damping; real failure also depends on strength, ductility and structural details.
• Numărul de etaje nu stabilește singur: • Floor count alone does not determine building safety. Frequencies, strength, site conditions and seismic motion vary from case to case.
• Lecție: demonstrația explică un oscila: • Lesson: this demonstration explains a linear single-degree-of-freedom oscillator; it does not implement a design code or assess safety.
Curba arată răspunsul staționar la excit: The curve shows steady harmonic response, not an earthquake response spectrum. A seismic spectrum uses peak responses to an accelerogram for oscillators with different natural periods and specified damping.
Un izolator reduce frecvența proprie. Tr: An isolator reduces the natural frequency. Absolute displacement transmissibility is Tᵣ=√(1+(2ζr)²)/√((1−r²)²+(2ζr)²), with Tᵣ<1 when r>√2. Relative displacement may remain large; actual cost and effectiveness depend on design.
Un teren moale poate amplifica anumite b: Soft soil can amplify particular frequency bands. Response may grow when the dominant excitation frequency approaches the natural frequency. This is schematic, not a reconstruction of a historical earthquake.
• P și S sunt unde de volum; Love și Ray: • P and S are body waves; Love and Rayleigh are surface waves. Each can have a broad spectrum; wave type does not universally determine the height of affected buildings.
Animație încetinită de 50 ori; frecvența: Animation slowed by a factor of 50; natural frequency is n·v/(2L).
Model liniar didactic: x este deplasarea: Educational linear model: x is displacement relative to the ground. Geometry, materials, soil, visual indices and sounds are schematic. The seismogram is synthetic, not a historical recording. This model does not calculate building damage or safety.

Modurile și rapoartele sunt o sinteză il: The modes and ratios are an illustrative synthesis. Real bowl frequencies depend on geometry, thickness and material; these recipes are not measurements.

La t₀, toate punctele frontului plan emi: At t₀, all points on the plane wavefront simultaneously emit elementary spherical waves. The orange centres stay fixed; the blue circles are sections of the elementary waves, all with the same radius r = v·Δt. Their common green tangent is the front at t₀ + Δt, propagating to the right.
La t₀, toate punctele frontului sferic e: At t₀, all points on the spherical wavefront simultaneously emit elementary spherical waves. The orange centres stay fixed on the sphere of radius R₀; all blue circles have radius r = v·Δt. The outer green envelope has radius R₀ + v·Δt. The drawing is a cross-section through the spheres.
O singură generație se construiește și s: One generation is constructed and stops. “Next front” sets the new instant t₀; only then can another set of elementary waves start. The drawing scale adjusts between generations.
La un moment fixat t₀, fiecare punct al: At a fixed instant t₀, each point on the wavefront is the source of an elementary spherical wave. All these waves start simultaneously; after the same interval Δt, their envelope in the propagation direction is the wavefront at t₀ + Δt.
Propagarea este continuă: la fiecare sec: Propagation is continuous: every second, the new front automatically becomes the front at t₀ for the next stage. The scale stays fixed; the demonstration replays when the next stage would leave the drawing. The Δt slider (0–1 s) and −/+ buttons pause playback to inspect the current stage step by step.
